name: Esther's
source:
At Esther's cafe your adorable host
Served cheese to the mice when they wanted toast!
That won't bother Harold's robust appetite,
But Janie insists that the order's not right.

[From [url=https://bcb-eng.itch.io/esthers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在埃斯特的咖啡馆里，你可爱的主人
当老鼠想吐司时，给它们提供奶酪！
这不会影响哈罗德旺盛的胃口，
但珍妮坚持认为这个顺序不正确。

[来自[url=https://bcb-eng.itch.io/esthers]itch.io[/url]]
